model.query:
from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "usg" and r._field == "mem" and r.mac == "74:fa:29:54:00:f1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

annotations.summary: UDM memory (usg.mem) >85% for 5+ minutes. earlyoom will start killing processes (likely unifi-core, the controller) when available memory drops below ~10%. This is the precursor to a controller crash loop. See runbooks/udm-unifi-core-crash-loop.md. Reduce controller workload (IPS was the 2026-10-15 load driver; DPI is next). Restart via SSH (`systemctl restart unifi-core`) or the web UI. NOTE: usg.mem lags real kernel state — verify via SSH (free -h, earlyoom syslog) before acting.
